name: NVIDIA RTX A2000 product page (6 GB or 12 GB GDDR6 ECC, 70 W)
notes: Product page covers both SKUs: 6 GB or 12 GB GDDR6 with ECC, max power 70 W, PCIe Gen4 x16, low-profile dual-slot, Ampere. Bus width and bandwidth are not on this page. The llama.cpp Vulkan row does not state which SKU was measured; the accelerator record is the 12 GB SKU because that is the one that fits a 7B Q4 fully with KV headroom, and the ambiguity is noted.
